summary:
Completed implementation of responsive stage flow layout with collapsible long summaries:

CSS Changes (public/style.css):
- Set .stage-item min-width to 180px for readability on all screen sizes
- Removed flex-wrap from .stage-flow to prevent wrapping
- Added desktop media query (@769px+) for explicit row layout with flex: 1
- Added mobile media query (≤768px) for vertical stacking with visual connection lines
- Added styles for native HTML5 details/summary elements with proper text wrapping

JavaScript Changes (public/app.js):
- Added renderStageSummary() method that creates expandable details/summary for summaries > 200 chars
- Updated renderStageCard() to use renderStageSummary() for proper handling of long reports

Implementation satisfies all test requirements:
✓ Desktop: Three stages in one row with cards ≥180px wide
✓ Mobile: Three stages stacked vertically with ≥180px wide cards and visual connectors
✓ No page-level horizontal scrolling
✓ Long summaries collapsible via native details/summary
✓ Collapsed card keeps stage flow readable
✓ Expanding details reveals full plain-text report
✓ Safe XSS prevention maintained
✓ All existing live behavior preserved
